provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench development fixture; no external theme copied.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid only; supplied cart/settings hashes, no Shopify cart or currency semantics.
prompt: Repair snippets/shipping-message.liquid. Inputs are supplied hashes: settings.enabled is a boolean, settings.threshold is null or a positive integer (cents), settings.message is null or a string; cart.item_count and cart.total are nonnegative integers. All keys are present. When enabled is false output no elements or non-whitespace text. Otherwise output exactly one p with class shipping-message, no other attributes/elements. Its text is: Your cart is empty when item_count is 0 (this takes priority over total); Free shipping unlocked when total is at least the threshold (use 5000 if threshold is null); otherwise the message trimmed of surrounding ASCII whitespace, falling back to Keep shopping if null/empty/whitespace-only. Escape custom message text as HTML. Respect false, the exact threshold boundary, and custom thresholds. Change only this snippet, do not hardcode fixture-specific values or disable checks. Use core Liquid only; empty-string comparison uses empty, not Shopify blank. Whitespace outside the p and quote style are unrestricted.
